'''------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Description: deploy Maximo migration packages to target environments as defined in the config.yml file.
Modification History:
Date            Version                      Author                        Comment
===================================================================================================
2024-02-09      1.0                         IBM/Ammar Younes            Initial version 
2024-04-11      1.1                         IBM/Samer Al Fakih          Add support for additional artifcats (SYSPROP, INDEX..etc)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------'''
import java.util.Hashtable;
from psdi.util.logging import MXLoggerFactory

logger = MXLoggerFactory.getLogger("maximo.script")

logger.info(" Start IBMCFGTRCKBSAVE script \n")

# Initialize an empty hash table
Hashtable = {}

# Populate the hash table with the artifactname attribute name and artifacttype values
for artifactKeyAttributes in [("AUTOSCRIPT", ["AUTOSCRIPT"]),
              ("SIGOPTION", ["OPTIONNAME","APP"]),
              ("ATTRIBUTE", ["ATTRIBUTENAME","OBJECTNAME"]),
              ("LOOKUPMAP", ["ATTRIBUTENAME","OBJECTNAME"]),
              ("DOMAIN", ["DOMAIN"]),
              ("RELATIONSHIP", ["RELATIONSHIP","OBJECTNAME"]),
              ("OBJECT", ["OBJECTNAME"]),
              ("ACTION", ["ACTION"]),
              ("ACTIONGRP", ["ACTIONGRP"]),
              ("CONDITION", ["CONDITION"]),
              ("APP", ["APP"]),
              ("MENU", ["APP","OPTIONNAME","MENUTYPE"]),
              ("APPAUTH", ["GROUPNAME","APP"]),
              ("INTOBJECT", ["INTOBJECTNAME"]),
              ("ENDPOINT", ["ENDPOINT"]),
              ("COMTEMP", ["COMTEMP"]),
              ("IFACEIN", ["IFACEIN"]),
              ("IFACEOUT", ["IFACEOUT"]),
              ("ESCALATION", ["ESCALATION"]),
              ("WORKFLOW", ["WORKFLOW","WFREVISION"]),
              ("MESSAGE", ["MSGKEY","MSGGROUP"]),
              ("INTOBJECT", ["INTOBJECTNAME"]),
              ("SC", ["SCNAME"]),
              ("SYSPROP", ["PROPNAME"]),
              ("INDEX", ["INDEX","OBJECTNAME"]),
              ("XML", ["APP"]),
              ("QUERY", ["QUERY","APP"]),
              ("REPORT", ["REPORT","APP"]),
              ("SECGROUP", ["GROUPNAME"]),
              ("CRONTASK", ["CRONTASK"]),
              ("ROLE", ["ROLE"]),
              ("ORG", ["ORGID"]),
              ("CALENDAR", ["CALNUM","ORGID"]),
              ("MAXVARS", ["VARNAME","ORGID"]),
              ("EXTSYSTEM", ["EXTSYSTEM"])]:    
    Hashtable[artifactKeyAttributes[0]] = artifactKeyAttributes[1]


# Function to get the artifactname for a given artifacttype
def get_artifactname(artifacttype):
    return Hashtable.get(artifacttype)
    
# Call the function to get the artifactname for a given artifacttype
artifacttype = mbo.getString("artifacttype")
artifact = get_artifactname(artifacttype)
if artifact is not None:
    artifactname=mbo.getString(artifact[0])
    mbo.setValue("artifactname",artifactname)
    if len (artifact)==2:
        artifactsecondkey=mbo.getString(artifact[1])
        mbo.setValue("artifactsecondkey",artifactsecondkey)
    elif len (artifact)==3:
        artifactsecondkey=mbo.getString(artifact[1])
        mbo.setValue("artifactsecondkey",artifactsecondkey)
        artifactThirdkey=mbo.getString(artifact[2])
        mbo.setValue("artifactThirdkey",artifactThirdkey)

logger.info(" End IBMCFGTRCKBSAVE script \n")
